content: Neɨkiya kememɨte'uwewi Kanaha kiekariyaritsie
Merikɨtsɨ hairieka tukari 'aye'aku mekaneitineɨkitɨani xeime, mɨkɨ 'ixɨarari mepewewiekai Kanaha kiekariyaritsie Karereya kwieyaritsie, Ketsutsi maamaya mana kaniuyeikakaitɨni.
Ketsutsi neɨkiyapa kaniuta'inierieni, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete meta mete'uta'inierie.
Hikɨ kaxie winuyari 'uyexɨxɨaku Ketsutsi maamaya mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Kaxie winuyari mepɨkahexeiyari.
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Nemaama, ¿ketita mɨkɨkɨ tetehexeiya? Netukari 'akuxi pɨka'aye'awe.
Hikɨ maamaya mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe teparewiwamete: —Mɨkɨ kemɨtixetahɨawe yaxeketenekahuni.
Merikɨtsɨ mana pɨtitekai tete ye'ɨrɨteyarite 'ataxewi paɨmetɨ huriyutsixi memukamaimawa memɨ'itiyanikɨ. Xexuimetsie katinakananakekaitɨni nauka tewiyari yatɨni xeitsienituyari rituruyari.
Hikɨ Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —Haa xekeneutihɨniya tete ye'ɨrɨteyariteta. Hikɨ kɨtsitana paitɨ mekanitihɨniya.
Mɨpaɨta katiniwarutahɨawe Ketsutsi: —Hikɨtari xekeniwatihapani, 'ixɨarari mɨhɨritɨarie hetsɨa xekenanuhapani. Hikɨ mɨkɨ mekaneihapanirieni.

Mɨhɨritɨarie kepauka menuti'inɨataxɨ haa kaxie winuyari matɨa, 'atsikatimaitɨ hakewa memiemetɨkai, tsepa teparewiwamete yamemɨtemaikai haa memɨwatihanakaikɨri, 'ixɨarari mɨhɨritɨariekai neneɨkeme kaniutahɨawe.

Mɨpaɨ katinitahɨawe: —Yunaitɨ teɨteri kaxie winuyari 'aixɨa ma'ane mekaniwa'itɨaka meri, kepauka memɨtitarɨweni 'axamɨ'ane 'ana mepɨwa'itɨa. 'Ekɨtsɨ pɨta pekanitikwerieni kaxie winuyari 'aixɨa ma'ane hikɨkeri temenu'ienikɨ.

'Ipaɨ matɨari katiniuyurieni Ketsutsi Kanahatsie Karereya kwieyaritsie 'itsutɨatɨ 'inɨari kemɨtiyurienekai. Matsiɨkɨtɨ kanayuyeitɨani kemɨtimariwekai, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete yuri mekateniuta'erieni hetsiena.
Merikɨtsɨ 'arikeke Kaperunaume mɨkɨ kaneuyeyune, maamaya, 'iwamama, meta teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama, mana mɨixa mepɨka'uyuri.
Ketsutsi tukita kemɨtiwarayeweiyaxɨa
Merikɨtsɨ huriyutsixi wa'ixɨarari Patsikwa mɨtitewa kanahurakaitɨni, Ketsutsi Kerutsareme kaneutiyune.
Mana tuki kuraruyarita kaniwaretaxeiya tuurutsixi memɨwatuakai, muxatsi, kukuruxi meta tumini patamete tiwaretaxei muwa me'ayeteme.
Kaunari tiyuwayame 'utawewieka tuki kuraruyarita meyunaime kaniwaranuyeweiya, muxatsi meta tuurutsixi wahamatɨa. Tumini patamete watumini kananakaxɨrieni, wamexate kanatixɨriexɨani.
Kukuruxi memɨwatuakai mɨpaɨ katiniwarutahɨawe: —'Ikɨ xekenanuye'ɨi takwa paitɨ. Ne'ukiyari kiiya tetuayamete wakii xepɨka'ayeitɨwani.
Teyɨ'ɨkitɨwamete mekaneye'erieni niuki mɨpaɨ mɨre'uxa: «'Akii nemɨkweriekɨ netaɨta nepɨtaxɨtsitɨariexime».
Hikɨ huriyutsixi mɨpaɨ mekatenita'eiya: —¿Ketita 'inɨariyari petatixeiyatsitɨani mɨyapemɨtiyurienekɨ?
Ketsutsi mɨpaɨ katiniwaruta'eiya: —'Ikɨ tuki xekeneuka'una, ne hairieka tukari 'anukayayu nekanenukuketɨamɨkɨ hutarieka.
'Ayumieme huriyutsixi mɨpaɨ mekaniutiyuani: —'Ikɨ tuki wewiyanetɨ huta tewiyari heimana 'ataxewime wiyari mekaniuyurieni. 'Ekɨri haika tukari perenukuketɨani.
Matsi mɨkɨ yuwaiyari kanixatakaitɨni tukitɨme.
Kepaukari mɨkite watsata manukuketɨarie, teyɨ'ɨkitɨwametemama mekane'eriwakaitɨni mɨpaɨ mutayɨkɨ. 'Ana 'utɨarika yuri mekateniuta'eririeni, meta Ketsutsi niukieya yuri mete'uta'eriri.
Ketsutsi kemɨtiwamaikai yunaime teɨteri
Merikɨtsɨ Kerutsareme 'uyeikakaku Patsikwa 'ixɨararipa, yumɨiretɨ yuri mekateniuta'erieni hetsiena me'ixeiyaka 'inɨarite mɨkɨ kemɨtiyurienekai.
Matsi Ketsutsi yuri pɨkatiwa'eririekai, mɨkɨ yunaime mɨwamaikaikɨ,
xewitɨ tewi hepaɨtsita mɨtitahekɨatɨanikɨ pɨkaheuyehɨakai, mɨkɨ yɨkɨmana mɨtimaikaikɨ tita tewi 'iyarieyatsie mɨtiyeka.
